---
title: "Publications"
---

# Publications

The table below is generated from `works.bib` and supports instant search and column sorting.

<link rel="stylesheet" href="assets/vendor/datatables/dataTables.dataTables.min.css">
<script src="assets/vendor/datatables/dataTables.min.js"></script>

<div id="pub-load-status">Loading publications from works.bib...</div>

<div id="pub-filters" style="display:none"></div>

<table id="pub-table" class="display accessible-table" style="width:100%" aria-label="Publications">
	<caption class="visually-hidden">Publications with year, title, authors, venue, type, and link.</caption>
	<thead>
		<tr>
			<th scope="col">Year</th>
			<th scope="col">Title</th>
			<th scope="col">Authors</th>
			<th scope="col">Venue</th>
			<th scope="col">Type</th>
			<th scope="col">Link</th>
		</tr>
	</thead>
	<tbody></tbody>
</table>

<script>
const cleanField = (value) => {
	if (!value) return "";
	const asText = String(value)
		.replace(/<[^>]*>/g, " ")
		.replace(/[{}]/g, "")
		.replace(/\\[a-zA-Z]+\s*/g, "")
		.replace(/\s+/g, " ")
		.trim();

	const decode = document.createElement("textarea");
	decode.innerHTML = asText;
	return decode.value;
};

const parseAuthors = (rawAuthors) => {
	if (!rawAuthors) return "";
	return cleanField(rawAuthors)
		.split(/\s+and\s+/i)
		.map((name) => name.trim())
		.filter(Boolean)
		.join(", ");
};

const entryLink = (fields) => {
	const doi = cleanField(fields.doi || fields.DOI);
	const url = cleanField(fields.url || fields.URL);
	if (doi) return `https://doi.org/${doi}`;
	return url;
};

const escapeRegex = (value) => String(value).replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, "\\$&");

const createDataTable = (selector, options) => {
	if (typeof window.DataTable === "function") {
		return new window.DataTable(selector, options);
	}

	if (window.jQuery?.fn?.DataTable) {
		return window.jQuery(selector).DataTable(options);
	}

	return null;
};

const parseBibEntries = (text) => {
	const entries = [];
	const normalized = String(text || "").replace(/\r\n/g, "\n");
	let index = 0;

	const skipWhitespace = () => {
		while (index < normalized.length && /\s/.test(normalized[index])) {
			index += 1;
		}
	};

	const readUntil = (terminator) => {
		const start = index;
		while (index < normalized.length && normalized[index] !== terminator) {
			index += 1;
		}
		return normalized.slice(start, index);
	};

	const readBalancedBlock = (openChar, closeChar) => {
		let depth = 1;
		const start = index;
		while (index < normalized.length) {
			const char = normalized[index];
			if (char === openChar) depth += 1;
			if (char === closeChar) depth -= 1;
			index += 1;
			if (depth === 0) break;
		}
		return normalized.slice(start, index - 1);
	};

	const parseFields = (body) => {
		const fields = {};
		let i = 0;

		const readFieldValue = () => {
			skipFieldWhitespace();
			if (body[i] === "{") {
				i += 1;
				let depth = 1;
				const start = i;
				while (i < body.length) {
					const char = body[i];
					if (char === "{") depth += 1;
					if (char === "}") depth -= 1;
					i += 1;
					if (depth === 0) break;
				}
				return body.slice(start, i - 1);
			}

			if (body[i] === '"') {
				i += 1;
				const start = i;
				while (i < body.length) {
					if (body[i] === '"' && body[i - 1] !== "\\") break;
					i += 1;
				}
				const value = body.slice(start, i);
				i += 1;
				return value;
			}

			const start = i;
			while (i < body.length && body[i] !== ",") {
				i += 1;
			}
			return body.slice(start, i).trim();
		};

		const skipFieldWhitespace = () => {
			while (i < body.length && /\s/.test(body[i])) {
				i += 1;
			}
		};

		while (i < body.length) {
			skipFieldWhitespace();
			if (i >= body.length) break;

			const keyStart = i;
			while (i < body.length && /[\w\-]/.test(body[i])) {
				i += 1;
			}
			const key = body.slice(keyStart, i).trim();
			skipFieldWhitespace();
			if (body[i] !== "=") {
				break;
			}
			i += 1;
			const value = readFieldValue();
			if (key) fields[key] = value;
			skipFieldWhitespace();
			if (body[i] === ",") {
				i += 1;
			}
		}

		return fields;
	};

	while (index < normalized.length) {
		const at = normalized.indexOf("@", index);
		if (at === -1) break;
		index = at + 1;
		skipWhitespace();

		const typeStart = index;
		while (index < normalized.length && /[A-Za-z]/.test(normalized[index])) {
			index += 1;
		}
		const entryType = normalized.slice(typeStart, index).toLowerCase();
		skipWhitespace();
		if (normalized[index] !== "{") {
			continue;
		}
		index += 1;

		const key = readUntil(",").trim();
		if (normalized[index] === ",") index += 1;
		const body = readBalancedBlock("{", "}");
		const entryTags = parseFields(body);

		entries.push({ entryType, citationKey: key, entryTags });
	}

	return entries;
};

const loadPublications = async () => {
	const status = document.getElementById("pub-load-status");
	const tbody = document.querySelector("#pub-table tbody");
	const filters = document.getElementById("pub-filters");

	const yearLabel = document.createElement("label");
	yearLabel.htmlFor = "pub-year-filter";
	yearLabel.textContent = "Year: ";

	const yearFilter = document.createElement("select");
	yearFilter.id = "pub-year-filter";
	yearFilter.setAttribute("aria-label", "Filter publications by year");
	yearFilter.setAttribute("aria-controls", "pub-table");
	yearFilter.innerHTML = '<option value="">All</option>';
	yearLabel.appendChild(yearFilter);

	const typeLabel = document.createElement("label");
	typeLabel.htmlFor = "pub-type-filter";
	typeLabel.textContent = "Type: ";

	const typeFilter = document.createElement("select");
	typeFilter.id = "pub-type-filter";
	typeFilter.setAttribute("aria-label", "Filter publications by type");
	typeFilter.setAttribute("aria-controls", "pub-table");
	typeFilter.innerHTML = '<option value="">All</option>';
	typeLabel.appendChild(typeFilter);

	try {
		const response = await fetch("works.bib");
		if (!response.ok) {
			throw new Error(`Could not load works.bib (HTTP ${response.status})`);
		}

		const bibText = await response.text();
		const entries = parseBibEntries(bibText);

		const rows = entries.map((entry) => {
			const fields = entry.entryTags || {};
			const year = cleanField(fields.year || "");
			const title = cleanField(fields.title || "");
			const authors = parseAuthors(fields.author || "");
			const venue = cleanField(fields.journal || fields.booktitle || fields.publisher || "");
			const type = cleanField(entry.entryType || "");
			const link = entryLink(fields);

			return { year, title, authors, venue, type, link };
		});

		rows.sort((a, b) => Number(b.year || 0) - Number(a.year || 0));

		const years = [...new Set(rows.map((row) => row.year).filter(Boolean))]
			.sort((a, b) => Number(b) - Number(a));
		const types = [...new Set(rows.map((row) => row.type).filter(Boolean))]
			.sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b));

		years.forEach((year) => {
			const option = document.createElement("option");
			option.value = year;
			option.textContent = year;
			yearFilter.appendChild(option);
		});

		types.forEach((type) => {
			const option = document.createElement("option");
			option.value = type;
			option.textContent = type;
			typeFilter.appendChild(option);
		});

		filters.replaceChildren(yearLabel, typeLabel);

		tbody.innerHTML = rows
			.map((row) => {
				const safeLink = row.link
					? `<a href="${row.link}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" aria-label="View publication: ${row.title}">View</a>`
					: "";

				return `
					<tr>
						<td>${row.year}</td>
						<th scope="row">${row.title}</th>
						<td>${row.authors}</td>
						<td>${row.venue}</td>
						<td>${row.type}</td>
						<td>${safeLink}</td>
					</tr>
				`;
			})
			.join("");

		const table = createDataTable("#pub-table", {
			pageLength: 25,
			order: [[0, "desc"]],
			columnDefs: [
				{ targets: 0, type: "num", orderable: true },
				{ targets: [1, 2, 3, 4], orderable: true },
				{ targets: 5, orderable: false }
			],
		});

		if (!table) {
			status.textContent = `Loaded ${rows.length} publications from works.bib. DataTables did not load, so advanced sorting/filtering is unavailable.`;
			return;
		}

		const applyFilters = () => {
			const yearValue = yearFilter.value;
			const typeValue = typeFilter.value;

			table
				.column(0)
				.search(yearValue ? `^${escapeRegex(yearValue)}$` : "", true, false);
			table
				.column(4)
				.search(typeValue ? `^${escapeRegex(typeValue)}$` : "", true, false);
			table.draw();
		};

		yearFilter.addEventListener("change", applyFilters);
		typeFilter.addEventListener("change", applyFilters);
		filters.style.display = "block";

		status.textContent = `Loaded ${rows.length} publications from works.bib.`;
	} catch (error) {
		status.textContent = `Unable to load publications: ${error.message}`;
	}
};

loadPublications();
</script>
